task_title: Floor 3 slice 12: onboarding, starter, and poach UX surfaces

plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review before coding. Blockers: (1) headless runner only resolved the loadout pause once at floor start, so a mid-run poach would stall Floor 3 forever -> added generic mid-loop resolution; (2) pausing inside the studio-defeat loop could double-fire or interleave with terminal transitions -> offer is now raised at the top of a fresh playing tick behind a poachOffered latch; (3) reinterpreting a Studio as a Trainer -> offer contract kept generic (floor3PoachOffer) with Studio-handler defeat documented as its only current producer until roaming Trainers land; (4) candidates must carry the Trainer roster level -> Floor3PoachCandidate carries {speciesId, level} and recruits at that level. Non-blocking: never-strand fallback on out-of-range picks, and duplicate species collapsing to the highest level.
